slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do all three products have to be processed in the same fixed sequence of machines (Machine 1 → Machine 2 → Machine 3), or is the machine sequence itself something we can choose as part of the schedule?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether all products follow a fixed machine sequence, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the schedule — are we minimizing the total time until all three products are completely finished (makespan), or something else like minimizing total idle time or total flow time?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for clarification of the objective and whether it means makespan, matching the semantic hit rule.
